sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Interleukin-6 is a pleiotropic cytokine that contributes to synovial inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis and drives C-reactive protein production in the liver.

sec.title: Mechanism
sec.p: IL-6 trans-signalling through soluble IL-6 receptor activates JAK/STAT3 in synovial fibroblasts and promotes Th17 cell differentiation, which amplifies joint inflammation.

sec.title: Therapy
sec.p: Blocking the IL-6 receptor with tocilizumab reduces disease activity scores and improves physical function in patients with rheumatoid arthritis.
